summary.text: Will Smith is a Democratic member of the Maryland State Senate from District 20 who has served since December 2016 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
An attorney and U.S. Naval Reserve intelligence officer, he chairs the Judicial Proceedings Committee.

paragraphs.text: Smith, whose legislative name is William C. Smith, Jr., was born in Silver Spring, Maryland, on February 6, 1982.

He earned a bachelor's degree in government from the College of William and Mary in 2004, a master's degree in government from The Johns Hopkins University in 2006, a law degree from William and Mary's Marshall-Wythe School of Law in 2009, and a master's degree in strategic intelligence from the National Intelligence University in 2018.

He has been an intelligence officer in the U.S. Naval Reserves since 2009, was an associate at The Federal Practice Group from 2014 to 2016, and has been of counsel at the Solomon Law Firm since 2018.
Smith served in the House of Delegates from 2014 to 2016, was appointed to the Senate on December 13, 2016, and has been a member since December 21, 2016.
He has chaired the Judicial Proceedings Committee since 2020 and also serves on the Rules and Executive Nominations committees.
His public service listing includes serving as director of the Homeland Security Advisory Council at the U.S. Department of Homeland Security from 2011 to 2013 as a White House appointee.
He advanced from the Democratic primary on June 23, 2026.
